title: Lift m3kit libs into this workspace

libs.description: m3kit libs to lift. The dependency closure (core/theme/...) is included automatically.
libs.x-prompt: Which m3kit libs should be lifted (e.g. table dashboard)?

scope.description: Your TypeScript alias prefix: libs are wired as @<scope>/<lib> and tagged scope:<scope>-<lib>.

ref.description: Git ref (branch, tag, or SHA) of the m3kit repo to lift from. Defaults to main.

repo.description: GitHub <owner>/<repo> to download the source tarball from.

sourceDir.description: Internal/testing: directory containing an already-extracted m3kit workspace (skips the tarball download).
